mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS spuId, s.name AS title, s.pic_url AS imageUrl, (SELECT MIN(retail_price) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = s.id AND deleted = 0) AS price, (SELECT MIN(market_price) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = s.id AND deleted = 0) AS originalPrice, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(stock) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = s.id AND deleted = 0), 0) AS stock, s.sales, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(stock) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = s.id AND deleted = 0), 0) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasStock, s.status = 1 AS isOnSale FROM pms_spu_group_relation r JOIN pms_spu s ON r.spu_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE r.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY r.sort ASC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.pic_url AS picUrl, s.description AS simpleDesc, (SELECT MIN(retail_price) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = s.id AND deleted = 0) AS price, (SELECT MIN(market_price) FROM pms_sku WHERE spu_id = s.id AND deleted = 0) AS originPrice, s.sales, s.spu_type AS spuType FROM pms_spu_group_relation r JOIN pms_spu s ON r.spu_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE r.group_id = #{groupId} AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort ASC
